messages:
maria_ml: FYI ran a holdout sweep (5k dev docs) on new vectormodel 'redwood-embed-v2-int8' — seeing recall@10 drop ~6% on long-tail queries vs baseline. Raw plots in drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example

sam_irving: can you paste the eval config?

maria_ml: config used:
```
{ dataset: "wiki_holdout", k: 10, metric: "cosine", index: "faiss_ivf", dims: 1536, quant: "INT8", nlist: 4096, nprobe: 16 }
```

anika: what's the magnitude of the regression?

maria_ml: recall@10 baseline: 0.734 -> new: 0.678 (6.4% abs drop). recall@1 baseline: 0.621 -> 0.595. silhouette -0.02 overall; cluster purity down ~3 pts on tail buckets.

kevin_ops: hardware + index params identical? did you rebuild index after quant?

maria_ml: yes same infra (a100-80g), rebuilt index post-quant. Also ran a float16 quant run: float16 has ~0.9% drop, so issue seems specific to INT8 path.

eval-bot: ALERT: regression detected on metric recall@10 (delta > 5%) for model redwood-embed-v2-int8 at 2026-03-20T13:40:10Z

anika: any difference by query length?

maria_ml: short queries (len < 10 tokens) stable (+0.4%), medium 1-2% drop, long-tail (rare terms, low doc freq) worst hit.

sam_irving: hypothesis: per-channel scale mismatch in our post-training quant flow for rare-token embeddings. Can you run INT8 with per-channel scaling and L2 normalization pre/post quant?

maria_ml: launching two experiments: (A) per-channel INT8, (B) per-tensor INT8 + L2 normalize after quant. ETA ~2 hrs. kicking off with small 50k shard.

kevin_ops: should we enable fallback for prod routing to avoid exposing regression? I can flip routing flag.

anika: yes enable fallback to redwood-embed-v1 for the affected dedicated customers and canary routes. route: /model-routing/fallback=redwood-embed-v1

maria_ml: pushed a canary patch to the model bundle that logs cosine drift per query. sample output:
```
query: "obscure enzyme XYZ"
baseline_cosine: 0.82
int8_cosine: 0.64
delta: -0.18
```

sam_irving: add a golden tailset of 100 hand-picked queries to daily evals and surface per-bucket recall in the UI.

maria_ml: added golden_tailset -> /ci/evals/embedding_tailset.yml, and updated the PR for eval dashboard. CI run scheduled.

kevin_ops: created tracking ticket INC-2026-54, assigned to eng-ml.

anika: please add a short note to the release channel and ping support once fallback is enabled so SRE & support can notify key customers.

maria_ml: will post results from the per-channel run once complete. Thanks all :thumbsup:
